First impressions

matter to us

At Mayra Dental Clinic, you’re cared for by a specialty-led team known for solving complex cases with meticulous planning and elite-level precision, but never at the expense of kindness. We slow things down, listen first, explain clearly, and make sure you feel in control of every decision.

A different kind of first visit

In your 60–90 minute new patient exam, we focus on understanding the full picture, so nothing is rushed or overlooked. You can expect:
  • A thorough evaluation of your dental and medical history, teeth, gums, and bite
  • Clear insights supported by high-quality photos and, when needed, advanced diagnostics
  • A one-on-one consultation with Dr. Sumar, including a personalized treatment plan with options
If additional imaging is recommended, we’ll take the time to explain why before proceeding. These services are separate from the initial examination fee. You’ll leave informed, supported, and confident in your next steps.

Extra support, if you need it

If dental visits make you feel tense, you’re not alone. That’s why we offer Exomind, a non-invasive therapy designed to calm the nervous system and ease stress before or after your visit.

Request your first Exomind session at no cost while you’re under our care.

Traveling to See Us?

If you’re coming in from out of town, we’re here to make the process as smooth as possible.
We can help you coordinate:
  • Efficient scheduling to minimize repeat trips
  • Guidance on nearby hotels and accommodations
  • Recommendations for local restaurants and amenities
  • Clear communication with your referring provider, if applicable

Complex treatment often requires careful planning, and when you’re traveling, that planning matters even more. Our team will walk you through timelines, appointment sequencing, and what to expect, so you can arrange your visit with confidence.

Have questions before you book your trip? Call us at (780) 421-4441. We’re happy to help you plan.

Small touches

Big Difference

Dental visits can feel like a lot. Our comfort menu is here to help you slow down, get comfortable, and feel cared for before, during, and after your visit.

Something to sip

Enjoy complimentary barista-style coffee and espresso drinks, Tazo® tea, Flow alkaline water, Bubly® sparkling water, organic coconut water, or Oasis® apple juice.

Something light

Grab a quick bite with MadeGood® organic snacks, premium protein bars, or a Premier Protein® shake in chocolate or vanilla.

Comfort, on your terms

Settle in with a cozy blanket, support pillow, aromatherapy, eye covering, or warm towelette. Plus Netflix, headphones, mood lighting, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

A seamless payment experience

We accept cash, checks, and major credit cards, and we’ll always review costs with you upfront. Our team can walk you through the options and help you find a payment approach that feels comfortable and realistic. High-quality dental care is an investment in your long-term health, function, and confidence, and we want that investment to feel more manageable.

Call us at (780) 421-4441 if you’d like help understanding your financing options before booking.

Dental Financing Options

0% dental financing – only at Mayra

We’re proud to be the only specialty clinic offering 0% financing for prosthodontic and periodontal treatment.

Through our partnership with Beautifi, approved patients can break treatment into manageable monthly payments with zero interest!

Depending on approval, financing may offer:
  • 0% financing for eligible patients
  • Terms ranging from 6 months to 6 years
  • No money down required
  • No prepayment penalties
  • Financing available up to $25,000
  • No impact on your credit score to apply

How it Works

  1. Submit an Application through Beautifi

  2. Speak With a Specialist to confirm your financing details

  3. Schedule Your Treatment with Mayra Dental Clinic
The entire process is 100% online, fast, and secure with no impact on your credit score.

Your Questions,

Answered

What makes Mayra Dental Clinic different from a general dental office?
Mayra is a specialty-led, multidisciplinary practice. Your care is guided by advanced training, meticulous planning, and experience with complex cases — often for patients who haven’t found answers elsewhere. We focus on doing things right, not quickly.
I’m not sure what treatment I need. Is that okay?
Absolutely. Many patients come to us knowing something doesn’t feel right, but not knowing the solution. Our role is to listen, evaluate thoroughly, and explain your options clearly — so you can make informed decisions at your own pace.
What if I feel anxious about dental visits?
You’re not alone. We slow the process down, explain everything as we go, and prioritize your comfort. From our calm environment to optional support like Exomind and our comfort menu, we’re here to help you feel at ease.
Will I feel pressured to move forward with treatment?
No. Your first visit is about understanding, not committing. We’ll walk you through findings and options, answer your questions, and give you the space to decide what feels right for you.
Do you handle complex or long-term cases?
Yes, that’s one of our specialties. Mayra Dental Clinic is built to handle complex, restorative, and multidisciplinary cases that often require advanced planning and a more thoughtful long-term approach. Many of our patients come to us after feeling overlooked elsewhere or after learning their case needs a higher level of expertise. Here, treatment is planned with precision, collaboration, and long-term function in mind, so your care is built to last.
